== Update September 30, 2026 ==

=== New item for sale ===
* [[Infinite Stalker's Ration and Bird's Eye Compass Bundle]] - $9.99 USD - If you have this account upgrade, the Purveyor will provide you [[Infinite Stalker's Ration]] and [[Infinite Bird's Eye Compass|Bird's Eye Compass]] items. Both shop items have unlimited usage.  The individual item behavior is otherwise equivalent to the versions that drop in-game.
 
=== Reforged Coin schedule changes ===
If you have purchased the [[Merchant Summoning Item - Purveyor's Bell|Merchant Summoning Item 'Purveyor's Bell']] account upgrade, [[the Purveyor]] will hold onto your daily [[Reforged Coin]]s for up to three days. When you check in with him, the Purveyor gives you the coins stored since your last visit (up to three), so you can skip a day or two without losing any. Coins beyond three days' are not stored, so if you want to maximize your Reforged coint count, check in at least once every three days.  This is so as a player you don't feel you need to login every day just to get Reforged Coins.
 
=== Mobile and controller targeting improvements ===
* [[Target]]ing improvements when using a controller (or the virtual joysticks on mobile):
** Automatic targeting now more heavily favors closer targets
** The number of instances where auto-attack cancels unexpectedly has been greatly reduced
** No changes have been made to mouse/keyboard targeting

== Hotfix ==
* Fixed a bug that was preventing quest-related spawns from appearing
* Fixed a crash related to switching secondary professions
* Fixed a disconnect issue entering some PvP matches

=== Guild Wars Wiki notes ===
* Several missing translations have been added.
* The original update caused the following bugs:
** Allied NPC's and enemies did not spawn in missions or explorable areas. As such it was shortly impossible to complete certain quests or missions while at the same time possible to vanquish whole areas or complete mission without ever engaging any enemies.
** Changing the secondary profession crashed the game.
** Many [[portal]]s stopped working.
* Hotfix build: 38,967
